# Mountly

> Mountly is an open-source, lightweight macOS utility designed for seamless external drive detection, partition management, and write-support mounting for non-native filesystems (NTFS, exFAT, EXT4, APFS, and HFS+).

Mountly provides an elegant Apple-native menu bar and window experience built on Apple DiskArbitration APIs. It operates with zero telemetry, complete privacy isolation, and native Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) plus Intel 64-bit universal binary compatibility.

## Technical Specifications

- **Target Platform**: macOS 13.0 (Ventura), macOS 14.0 (Sonoma), macOS 15.0 (Sequoia) and newer.
- **Architecture**: Universal macOS Binary (Apple Silicon ARM64 + Intel x86_64).
- **Supported Filesystems**:
  - NTFS: Read and full Write mode support.
  - exFAT: Native high-speed mounting and multi-partition recovery.
  - APFS & HFS+: Full Apple native volume management and container inspection.
  - FAT32: Legacy thumbdrive compatibility.
- **Privacy Model**: 100% Offline. Zero analytics SDKs, zero user tracking, zero cloud telemetry.
- **System Footprint**: Under 15MB installed, idle RAM under 25MB, negligible CPU usage.
